state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 4.** `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections (`connect`, `open`) and runs `who_am_i`, `search` and `read`. `nvs_ldap::Filter::Encoded` and `nvs_ldap::is_attribute_description` are on `main`.

**The Stage 4 members are on `main`**: `Ldap\Connection::whoami`/`search`/`read`, `Ldap\Entries`, `Ldap\Entry` (`dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes`), `Ldap\Filter` (`equals`, `present`) and `Ldap\Scope` (`Base`, `OneLevel`, `Subtree`). Each has at least three `.nvst` cases under `tests/conformance/core/ldap-*.nvst`. Six of those cases need no server. The others reach the `samba-ad` service in `tests/db/compose.yaml` at `ldaps://localhost:16636` as `CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=example,DC=test`. They are skipped through `--COPY--\n../../db/ca.crt` where `tests/db/ca.crt` is absent. The acceptance case `ldap-connect-and-search.nvst` passes against it.

`dn()` returns `string` until `Dn` exists (Stage 5). `toArray` and `Entries::references` are not written. `Ldap\Settings` still lacks `base` and `tlsCaFile`, so `open` cannot reach a server whose certificate needs a private CA.

items.text: **`Entry::toArray` and `Entries::references`** (ADR 0278 § 1 and § 5). The `Entry` rows start at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:465`, and the reader bodies at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:354`. `toArray`'s keys keep the server's spelling (the module doc at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:6`). Three cases each, against `samba-ad`, in the shape of `tests/conformance/core/ldap-entry-readers-agree-on-a-missing-attribute.nvst`.

**`Ldap\Settings` gains `base` and `tlsCaFile`** (ADR 0278 § 2). The shape is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:59`, and its slot constants follow it. Then add a case where `Core\Ldap::open` reaches `samba-ad` over LDAPS and `whoami` returns `u:EXAMPLE\Administrator`.

backlog: Stage 5: `Filter::all`/`any`/`not`, the rest of the matches, `Filter::parse` and `Dn` (ADR 0278 § 5). `dn()` then returns `Dn`.
